# v13.3.0 release notes, iteration 1: the staging note behind its banner

## Context

#19712 is the epic for Engine 13.3.0's release notes. Its workflow ([release-notes §1](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-skills/blob/dev/.agents/skills/release-notes/references/release-notes-workflow.md)) merges iteration 1 early, behind a banner, and refines it in mining-driven leaves. Two days after the epic was filed, it has no leaf, and `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.3.0.md` is missing on `dev` (checked at `d2014f4433`). So `publish.mjs prepare` for the cut record #19652 cannot start.

The stewards have deposited the mining on the epic:
- content-sized rows, cornerstone 1 ([deposit](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19712#issuecomment-6147367011));
- grid header menus, cornerstone 2 ([deposit](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19712#issuecomment-6148893430));
- a cut the maintainers can run, cornerstone 3 ([deposit](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19712#issuecomment-6188379297)), whose proof is the 13.3.0 cut itself;
- the Brain-gated e2e tier on every Engine PR ([deposit](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19712#issuecomment-6147669143)).

## The Problem

The deposits give the stories, but no document carries them. Live GitHub at 2026-10-15T09:00Z counts 48 merged PRs and 50 closed issues in `neomjs/neo` since 13.2.0 was published (2026-10-11T22:37:33Z). The corpus run (`analyzeClosedSinceRelease.mjs --corpus-root`) counts 46 PRs and 24 issues: 25 issues are still `OPEN` in the corpus's 07:25Z publication, frozen before their close (defect-note sent). Until that is repaired, the note's numbers come from live GitHub, at a stated time.

## The Architectural Reality

- `publish.mjs` requires `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v{version}.md` (`buildScripts/release/releaseState.mjs`) and keeps the file as the archive (release-notes §6).
- `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs` refuses `blob/main` and tag-ref Neo source links in every `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/*.md`. `dev` and commit refs pass.
- Precedent shape: `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.2.0.md` and its iteration history: pending designation lines, the banner, TL;DR, *in 2 Minutes*, chapters, upgrade path, Full Changelog.
- Both cornerstones are opt-in on `Neo.grid.Container`: `contentSizedRows_: false` and `columnMenu_: false` (`src/grid/Container.mjs`), with a per-column `columnMenu` override (`src/grid/column/Base.mjs`).

## The Fix

Author `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.3.0.md`:
- the header block, with `Release Type` and `Stability` pending the operator (§4), and the iteration banner;
- TL;DR and *13.3 in 2 Minutes*: the ROADMAP's theme ("The Grid Fits Its Content"), the scale, the short route through `examples/grid/contentSizedRows` and a `columnMenu` grid, and the limit;
- a chapter per cornerstone and one for the e2e tier, from the deposits, plus a War Story picked from their candidates;
- *Also in 13.3*: the window's other Engine changes, from the scope run;
- *Upgrading from 13.2*: what is opt-in and what changes behaviour, each verified against its PR;
- a Full Changelog tail from the live list, marked as regenerated at the cut.

Every number is checked against its primary when written (§4).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.3.0.md` exists on `dev` with the iteration-1 banner, and `Release Type` / `Stability` read as pending the operator.
- [ ] AC-2: The TL;DR, *13.3 in 2 Minutes*, the three cornerstone chapters and the e2e-tier chapter are drawn from #19712's deposits, and each number links its primary. The cut chapter does not claim the first PR-gated cut before #19652 has verified it.
- [ ] AC-3: The scale line names its source and time (live GitHub search), not the corpus count.
- [ ] AC-4: An honest-bounds passage separates e2e-proven behaviour from bounded witnesses: 10k rows rather than 100k, the 100k menu timings, the retry bridge until 2026-10-25.
- [ ] AC-5: Neo source links use `dev` or commit refs, and `Generate.spec.mjs` passes.
- [ ] AC-6: A GPT-family review approves before merge (release-notes §5).

## Out of Scope

- Screenshots of the 10k grid and the header menu with counts. They come in the next iteration, with the images in `neomjs/pages`.
- The final iteration's work: the cut's own receipt from #19652, removing the banner, regenerating the numbers at the cut head, the §7 checklist.
- Repairing the corpus's stale issue states.

## Avoided Traps

- **Counting from the corpus.** Today it undercounts closed issues by half.
- **A changelog dump.** The deposits carry the stories; the grouped list only closes the note.
- **Downplaying a short window.** 13.3's two cornerstones and the tier each went from a Discussion to merged work in one to two days. The note says that plainly.
